name: labs/williamtsalter__fielddinomicroscopy
title: Dino-Lite AM7515 USB microscope (dnx64.DNX64)
intro: Dino-Lite AM7515 USB microscope (dnx64.DNX64), adapted from williamtsalter/fielddinomicroscopy. It reads `device_name` and `device_id`; sets `exposure_value`, `ae_target` and `auto_exposure`; runs `set_led`, `set_flc_level` and `switch_off_illumination`. `set_led`: turn the microscope LED on or off (SetLEDState). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
